---
title: "Explore genomes"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

This is an early (phase B) interactive view. Each point is one genome. The hover label and the table show the species name and the strain. The Palette input has three modes: Site hues (the site-wide phylum colours), Distinct colours (up to 24 groups of the displayed set get separate colours, the rest are grey), and Auto (Distinct colours when one phylum is chosen and the colour level is not phylum). The page reads the URL parameters x, y, level, phylum, reps (0 or 1), logx, logy and palette (auto, site or distinct), for example `12_explore.html?level=order&phylum=Ascomycota`. Values that are not valid are ignored. Nothing here is controlled for phylogeny, so related genomes are not independent and the correlations below are descriptive only. The default shows all genomes. Use the toggle to restrict to representative genomes (one per species). The level pages use one representative per species, and the all-genome scatter plots on the Comparisons page use all genomes. Counts differ between these views.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
raw = {
  try {
    return await FileAttachment("data/genomes.json").json();
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
loadError = raw === null
  ? html`<div style="border:2px solid #b00020;padding:0.75em;border-radius:4px">The data file <code>data/genomes.json</code> could not be loaded, so the explorer is not available. Reload the page or use the static pages from the navigation bar.</div>`
  : html``
```

//| echo: false

logDefault = new Set(["genome_mb", "n50_bp", "median_intron_len_bp", "median_intergenic_bp", "n_genes"])

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// BEGIN parseExploreParams
function parseExploreParams(search, ctx) {
  // Read the query string. A value that is missing or not valid is left undefined (the page then uses its default).
  const q = new URLSearchParams(search || "");
  const out = {};
  const x = q.get("x"), y = q.get("y"), lv = q.get("level"), ph = q.get("phylum");
  if (x !== null && ctx.numFields.includes(x)) out.x = x;
  if (y !== null && ctx.numFields.includes(y)) out.y = y;
  if (lv !== null && ctx.levels.includes(lv)) out.level = lv;
  if (ph !== null && ctx.phyla.includes(ph)) out.phylum = ph;
  for (const [k, name] of [["reps", "reps"], ["logx", "logx"], ["logy", "logy"]]) {
    const v = q.get(k);
    if (v === "0" || v === "1") out[name] = v === "1";
  }
  const pal = q.get("palette");
  if (pal === "auto" || pal === "site" || pal === "distinct") out.palette = pal;
  return out;
}
// END parseExploreParams
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
urlParams = parseExploreParams(window.location.search, {numFields, levels: raw === null ? [] : raw.levels, phyla: phylaAll})
```

```{ojs}

```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof logy = Inputs.toggle({label: "Log y", value: (urlParams.logy !== undefined && yvar === (urlParams.y ?? "busco_complete")) ? urlParams.logy : logDefault.has(yvar)})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
pts = genomes.filter(d =>
  d[xvar] != null && d[yvar] != null &&
  (phylum === "All" || d.phylum === phylum) &&
  (repsOnly === "All genomes" || d.is_representative === true) &&
  (!logx || d[xvar] > 0) && (!logy || d[yvar] > 0))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
function pearson(a, b) {
  const n = a.length;
  if (n < 3) return NaN;
  const ma = d3.mean(a), mb = d3.mean(b);
  let sab = 0, saa = 0, sbb = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const da = a[i] - ma, db = b[i] - mb;
    sab += da * db; saa += da * da; sbb += db * db;
  }
  return sab / Math.sqrt(saa * sbb);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
function ranks(v) {
  const idx = d3.range(v.length).sort((i, j) => v[i] - v[j]);
  const r = new Array(v.length);
  let i = 0;
  while (i < idx.length) {
    let j = i;
    while (j + 1 < idx.length && v[idx[j + 1]] === v[idx[i]]) j++;
    const avg = (i + j) / 2 + 1;
    for (let k = i; k <= j; k++) r[idx[k]] = avg;
    i = j + 1;
  }
  return r;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
fmt = x => Number.isFinite(x) ? x.toFixed(3) : "not defined"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
stats = {
  const a = pts.map(d => d[xvar]), b = pts.map(d => d[yvar]);
  const la = logx ? a.map(Math.log10) : a, lb = logy ? b.map(Math.log10) : b;
  return {n: pts.length, pearson: pearson(la, lb), spearman: pearson(ranks(a), ranks(b))};
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p><strong>${stats.n.toLocaleString()}</strong> genomes shown. Pearson r${(logx || logy) ? " (log10)" : ""} = <strong>${fmt(stats.pearson)}</strong>. Spearman r = <strong>${fmt(stats.spearman)}</strong>. Both use the displayed points and ignore phylogeny.${(logx || logy) ? " Pearson r is computed on log10 of each logged axis, as in the static figures. Spearman r is rank-based and does not depend on the log scale." : ""}</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
colorMap = raw === null ? {} : raw.colors[level]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
groupsShown = {
  const n = d3.rollup(pts, v => v.length, d => d[level]);
  return Array.from(n.keys()).sort((a, b) => n.get(b) - n.get(a));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// BEGIN distinctPalette
function distinctPalette(groups, counts, palette, grey = "#9a9a9a") {
  // Map group -> colour. Groups are ranked by count (largest first), ties by name. The first palette.length
  // groups get palette colours in rank order. All other groups get the grey.
  const rank = Array.from(groups).sort((a, b) => (counts.get(b) - counts.get(a)) || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));
  const m = new Map();
  rank.forEach((g, i) => m.set(g, i < palette.length ? palette[i] : grey));
  return m;
}
// END distinctPalette
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
distinctColours = ["#4e79a7", "#f28e2b", "#e15759", "#76b7b2", "#59a14f", "#edc948", "#b07aa1", "#ff9da7", "#9c755f",
  "#17becf", "#bcbd22", "#6a3d9a", "#33a02c", "#ff7f00", "#a6cee3", "#fb9a99", "#b2df8a", "#fdbf6f", "#cab2d6",
  "#800000", "#008080", "#000075", "#333333", "#8c564b"]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
useDistinct = paletteMode === "Distinct colours" || (paletteMode === "Auto" && phylum !== "All" && level !== "phylum")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
groupCounts = d3.rollup(pts, v => v.length, d => d[level])
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
distinctMap = distinctPalette(groupsShown, groupCounts, distinctColours)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
colorOf = g => useDistinct ? distinctMap.get(g) : (colorMap[g] || "#9a9a9a")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
legendGroups = useDistinct ? groupsShown.filter(g => distinctMap.get(g) !== "#9a9a9a") : groupsShown.slice(0, 20)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
 const desc = `Scatter plot of ${label(xvar)} against ${label(yvar)}, coloured by ${level}, ${pts.length.toLocaleString()} genomes`;
 const fig = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 900),
  height: Math.min(520, Math.max(300, width * 0.7)),
  marginLeft: 55,
  caption: desc,
  x: {type: logx ? "log" : "linear", label: label(xvar), grid: true},
  y: {type: logy ? "log" : "linear", label: label(yvar), grid: true},
  color: {domain: groupsShown, range: groupsShown.map(colorOf)},
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(pts, {x: xvar, y: yvar, fill: level, r: 2.5, fillOpacity: 0.55,
      title: d => [d.species ?? d.id, d.strain, `${d.phylum} / ${d.class}`].filter(x => x).join("\n"), tip: true})
  ]
})
 const svg = fig.tagName.toLowerCase() === "svg" ? fig : fig.querySelector("svg");
 svg.setAttribute("aria-label", desc);
 svg.setAttribute("role", "img");
 return fig;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
useDistinct
  ? html`<div><div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(13em,1fr));gap:0.3em 1em;font-size:0.8em">${legendGroups.map(g => html`<span><span style="display:inline-block;width:0.9em;height:0.9em;background:${colorOf(g)};margin-right:0.3em;vertical-align:middle"></span>${g} (${groupCounts.get(g).toLocaleString()})</span>`)}${groupsShown.length > legendGroups.length ? html`<span><span style="display:inline-block;width:0.9em;height:0.9em;background:#9a9a9a;margin-right:0.3em;vertical-align:middle"></span>Other (${groupsShown.length - legendGroups.length} groups)</span>` : ""}</div><div style="font-size:0.8em;margin-top:0.4em">Colours are assigned within the displayed set. They differ from the site-wide phylum colours.</div></div>`
  : html`<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.4em 1em;font-size:0.85em">${legendGroups.map(g => html`<span style="white-space:nowrap"><span style="display:inline-block;width:0.9em;height:0.9em;background:${colorOf(g)};margin-right:0.3em;vertical-align:middle"></span>${g}</span>`)}${legendGroups.includes("Other (small groups)") ? html`<span>grey = pooled small groups</span>` : ""}${groupsShown.length > legendGroups.length ? html`<span>and ${groupsShown.length - legendGroups.length} more groups (not listed)</span>` : ""}</div>`
```

Top 10 displayed genomes by the y variable:

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(pts.slice().sort((a, b) => b[yvar] - a[yvar]).slice(0, 10).map(d => ({...d, species: d.species ?? d.id})), {
  columns: ["species", "strain", "phylum", "class", xvar, yvar],
  header: {species: "Species", strain: "Strain", phylum: "Phylum", class: "Class", [xvar]: raw && raw.columns[xvar].label, [yvar]: raw && raw.columns[yvar].label},
  layout: "auto"
})
```

Missing values (null in the data) are left out of a plot, so the count changes with the axes. BUSCO values come from the assembly, not from the prediction.
